title: The Drownlight F2 - The Lens Gallery
_note: Drownlight family rung 2 (drownlight_f2): the hymn darkened to D phrygian (every E flattened, the A chord turned to E-flat), carried an octave down on a hollow triangle, while a glass BELL answers it one bar late — the lamp's light leaking down the wells. Pedal-D bass, the clockwork every other beat. Same 76 BPM grid.
